versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Sentinel Reputation Intelligence skill.
- Provides AI agent trust scoring and detailed reputation data for 239+ ACP marketplace agents.
- Returns reliability grades (A–F), numeric scores, success rates, job counts, buyer diversity, and available services.
- Includes free demo endpoint and paid full-report endpoint with x402 micro-payments.
- Features an agent leaderboard and LLM-optimized endpoints.
- Documentation covers use cases and integration guidance with Nansen on-chain analytics.
